segments.mil7.4.2:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘āpassa pañca aṅgāni gahetabbānī’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni pañca aṅgāni gahetabbānī”ti?
segments.mil7.4.2:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, āpo susaṇṭhitamakampitamaluḷitasabhāvaparisuddho, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena kuhanalapananemittakanippesikataṃ apanetvā susaṇṭhitamakampitamaluḷitasabhāvaparisuddhācārena bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.2:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, āpassa paṭhamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.2:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, āpo sītalasabhāvasaṇṭhito, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena sabbasattesu khantimettānuddayasampannena hitesinā anukampakena bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.2:2.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, āpassa dutiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.2:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, āpo asuciṃ suciṃ karoti, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena gāme vā araññe vā upajjhāye upajjhāyamattesu ācariye ācariyamattesu sabbattha anadhikaraṇena bhavitabbaṃ anavasesakārinā.
segments.mil7.4.2:3.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, āpassa tatiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.2:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, āpo bahujanapatthito, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena appicchasantuṭṭhapavivittapaṭisallānena satataṃ sabbalokamabhipatthitena bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.2:4.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, āpassa catutthaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.2:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, āpo na kassaci ahitamupadahati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena parabhaṇḍanakalahaviggahavivādarittajjhānaaratijananaṃ kāyavacīcittehi pāpakaṃ na karaṇīyaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.2:5.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, āpassa pañcamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.2:6.3: Na mano vā sarīraṃ vā, maṃ-kate sakka kassaci;
segments.mil7.4.2:6.5: Kadāci upahaññetha, etaṃ sakka varaṃ vare’”ti.
